text:
renee: FYI deploybot auto-pinned sdk:2.8 -> sdk:2.7 on our dedicated pools in us-central during the 01:00 UTC change window. Seeing a bump in 4xx for client-side header validation. Anyone on-call for SDK infra?

deploybot: INFO pinned sdk:2.8 -> sdk:2.7 on pool:dedicated-us-central at 2026-03-20T01:04:59Z (trigger: 4xx rate > 1.5% for 120s). logs: /deploys/605123-sdkpin-log

tom: I pulled a few failing traces: clients sending new `x-rw-features` header get rejected by edge-router v1.12 when paired with sdk:2.8. Looks like the header parsing change in sdk:2.8 is stricter.

li: Ugh, that header change should have been gated by a compatibility flag. We had a note in the SDK PR but nobody annotated the rollout. Could be our canary missed traffic pattern.

devon: Is pinning SDK safe for dedicated pools? Pinning affects runtime-side libs; we need to ensure model-serving processes don't expect the new header. Any risk to embeddings jobs?

renee: Quick check: embeddings-only routes unaffected (they don't use the header). Main risk is user-facing generation endpoints. We had a few support tickets but no outage reported.

qa-bot: regression tests: sdk-header-parsing failing in nightly canary (CI job id: ci-9075). Marked regressions: header-escape, header-length.

tom: Given the noise, two options: 1) rollback sdk:2.8 on edge-router in us-central (smaller blast radius) or 2) patch SDK to accept legacy header formats (takes longer). What's faster for night window?

li: Rollback edge-router is faster. But need to watch for thrash if we flip back quickly. We should schedule a staged revert with canary then remainder.

renee: Proposal: schedule a staged rollback at 02:10 UTC (canary 5% for 10m). Meanwhile, mark the SDK PR with a compatibility follow-up and add a temporary compatibility flag in sdk config to accept legacy headers.

deploybot: SCHEDULED rollback job: rollback-edge-router-1.12 -> 1.11 in us-central at 2026-03-20T02:10:00Z (initiated by renee). job id: rb-605123-02

li: I'll prep the compat-flag patch, but won't ship in-prod until we confirm rollback. Will also open a post-rollback canary test for header acceptance.

qa-bot: Adding a canary test run to the job: header-compat-canary -> runs after phase1.

renee: During rollback we should avoid unpin/unfreeze automation. Let's add a temporary lock to prevent deploybot from auto-unpinning mid-rollout. Can someone flip that?

devon: I'll add a short TTL lock: ops/locks/auto-unpin -> hold until 2026-03-20T03:30:00Z. Patch applied.

deploybot: INFO rollback phase1 (canary 5%) started at 2026-03-20T02:10:12Z

qa-bot: header-compat-canary: run complete (10m) 30/150 failures, regression fixed after revert. Details: /ci/runs/ci-9075/canary

deploybot: INFO rollback complete (100%) at 2026-03-20T02:26:41Z

tom: After rollback, 4xx rate dropped to baseline. Pin remains in place until we have a clean SDK patch and a staged rollout plan.

li: I'll post a small SDK patch (accept-legacy-headers) and request a staged rollout with feature flagging. Expected ETA: PR + tests by EOD.

renee: Release note (internal): "2026-03-20: Emergency rollback of edge-router to 1.11 in us-central due to stricter header validation in sdk:2.8 causing elevated client 4xx. Temporary SDK pin applied. Follow-up: staged SDK patch and rollout with compatibility flag."

devon: Action items: 1) li to open SDK patch & staged rollout plan, 2) tom to monitor 48h telemetry and confirm no regressions, 3) renee to draft a short internal RCA and update release notes.

li: PR opened: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/872 (wip). I'll add a migration guide for partners.

deploybot: INFO unpin scheduled for 2026-03-20T04:30:00Z pending manual approval (auto-unpin lock present).

renee: Let's not unpin automatically. We'll validate staged rollout first. I'll ping infra operations to coordinate a controlled unpin later this week.

tom: QA note: add synthetic clients that emit both legacy and new header variants to canary traffic so we catch this next time.

devon: Noted. I'll add a canary traffic tweak and update the runbook with a checklist: "SDK header changes require canary traffic variant + staged flag".

li: Thanks everyone. Will update pull request and post a rollout schedule once tests pass.

qa-bot: Closing canary run. All subsequent checks green. No customer-facing incidents logged.
